backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two logo-related features (Navbar and Footer PNG logo usage) to their respective component files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of all frontend source files describing their purpose and key content for the Bluefire Cysec website.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base file defining OKLCH CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with Spanish locale, SEO meta tags targeting Reynosa PyMEs and maquiladoras, Montserrat font import, and the React root mount point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that composes the full Bluefire Cysec single-page site by assembling Navbar, seven content sections, Footer, and a floating WhatsApp button.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact section with a WhatsApp CTA, contact info display, and a validated Spanish-language form that shows a success state after submission.
frontend/src/components/DifferentiatorsS: Section highlighting four Bluefire Cysec differentiators (local support, operational continuity, IT/OT expertise, affordable pricing) displayed as icon cards with stats.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Fixed floating WhatsApp button in the bottom-right corner that links to a pre-filled WhatsApp message for service inquiries.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Dark-blue footer displaying the Bluefire Cysec PNG logo, tagline, services list, contact details, social media icons, dynamic copyright year, and attribution.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section for Bluefire Cysec with a background image, headline, CTA buttons (WhatsApp diagnostic and pricing scroll), and three stat highlights targeting Reynosa-area businesses.
frontend/src/components/MarketContextSec: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/MissionSection.t: Section explaining Bluefire Cysec's mission, displaying a problem/solution text block and a four-item highlights grid covering local presence, response time, IT/OT expertise, and operational continuity.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Fixed top navigation bar with smooth-scroll links, a logo, a WhatsApp CTA button, and a responsive hamburger menu for mobile viewports.
frontend/src/components/PilotProgramSect: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/PricingSection.t: Pricing section displaying four tiered packages (Básico, Estándar, Premium, Enterprise OT) as cards with MXN prices, feature lists, and WhatsApp CTA buttons; the Estándar plan is highlighted as most popular.
frontend/src/components/ReferralProgramS: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/SectorChart.tsx: Empty file with no content or exports.
Services section rendering five cybersecurity offerings (Asset Registry, Vulnerability Assessment, Remediation, Network Segmentation, Anti-Phishing Course) as styled cards with icons, color-coded top borders, and step tags.
frontend/src/components/TargetClientsSec: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/TestimonialsSect: Renders a testimonials section with three customer reviews (name, role, company, avatar, star rating, quote) displayed in a responsive 3-column grid with Bluefire Cysec brand styling.
Empty file with no content or exports defined.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, returning either an authenticated or anonymous actor based on the current Internet Identity, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider context and useInternetIdentity hook for managing DFINITY AuthClient login/logout state, persisting identity across page reloads, and exposing login status flags.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that configures Tailwind base/components/utilities, defines Bluefire Cysec brand color tokens (dark blue, bright blue, red) as CSS custom properties in OKLCH for both light and dark modes, and sets Montserrat as the base font.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with Bluefire Cysec brand colors (bf-dark, bf-blue, bf-red), custom box shadows (glow effects), Montserrat/JetBrains Mono fonts, and animation keyframes; includes typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing the Bluefire Cysec website build, tracking existing features (logo integration in navbar and footer), architectural notes, and image requirements for the brand logo asset.
